diskscope.description: A disk-usage analyzer with a shared Rust core, command-line tools and a [native macOS interface](native).

command-guard.description: [Configurable guardrails](safety) for [Claude Code](autonomous-development) and [coding agents](agents,autonomous-development), with [project-specific command and file rules](developer-tools).

coloph-migrations.description: A [PostgreSQL migration CLI](postgres,backend,developer-tools) with [inspectable schema state, immutable migrations and compatibility checks](safety).

clx.description: An experiment in turning APIs into [discoverable, composable CLIs](developer-tools) that [agents can use through the shell](agents,agent-harness).

pg-tx.description: A [Node.js library](backend,developer-tools) for [nested PostgreSQL transactions](postgres), built after tracing a subtle production bug in common transaction advice.

gcf-typescript-template.description: A minimal [TypeScript](typescript) [starter template](developer-tools) for [Google Cloud Functions](backend,devops), from before straightforward TypeScript support.

hn-comment-bot.description: A [Telegram bot](backend) that notifies Hacker News users about replies to their comments; currently offline, with a revival planned.
